column2: It really is okay for $$プリカ$$ to fight with everyone too...?!
Even if we cannot match them in power, with speed and technique, even we can...
Even if our strength cannot compare...
I want to share life and death with the person I love!!
Ever since I was a child, I have yearned to be a man...
I have lived presenting as a man ever since. For someone like me...
I think I can understand how that person has lived...
An announcement regarding the match just concluded...
Both teams suddenly stopped fighting during the match...
The matter is now under review. Please keep your $$勝人投票権$$s...
